sources.title: Self-Harness: Harnesses That Improve Themselves
sources.repository_translation: Turn failed or sparse proof lanes into explicit improvement candidates, then accept only changes that survive tests and exported evidence.

sources.title: Investigating Multi-Agent Deliberation in Law
sources.repository_translation: Represent high-stakes interpretations as competing viewpoints before collapsing them into one route, verdict, or recommendation.

sources.title: AI, Trust, and the War Room: Evidence from a Conjoint Experiment
sources.repository_translation: Expose evidence strength, human review posture, intended use, and oversight signals directly beside model or diagnostic output.

sources.title: AI Epistemic Risks: Emerging Mechanisms and Evidence
sources.repository_translation: Measure when a system narrows evidence, repeats itself, reduces human checking, or makes uncertainty harder to see.

mechanisms.label: Weakness mining from traces
mechanisms.why_it_matters: The repo can inspect traces and cluster repeated failures into concrete improvement proposals with acceptance gates.
mechanisms.next_test: Keep the harness-improvement endpoint tied to repeated failed traces.

mechanisms.label: Regression-gated change promotion
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Improvements become credible when they are promoted through tests, proof exports, and generated clients together.
mechanisms.next_test: Add an acceptance assertion that every public proof page has a matching export script.

mechanisms.label: Deliberative disagreement matrix
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Some tasks need structured disagreement before a single answer is safe to present, especially legal, healthcare, employment, and safety domains.
mechanisms.next_test: Expand fixtures with more role mixes and evidence sparsity patterns.

mechanisms.label: Trust calibration with oversight
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Users trust systems differently depending on purpose, precision, oversight, and human control. Those factors need visible state, not hidden prose.
mechanisms.next_test: Score every high-impact response for oversight, human review, and evidence freshness.

mechanisms.label: Epistemic friction against over-delegation
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Interfaces should help people keep checking, comparing, and asking better questions instead of quietly delegating judgment.
mechanisms.next_test: Add more domain fixtures for stale evidence, repeated claims, and missing human review.

mechanisms.label: Feedback-loop and lock-in monitoring
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Homogenization can look like stability until the system has already stopped seeing important variation.
mechanisms.next_test: Add longitudinal drift fixtures for repetition, source narrowing, and language collapse.

feature_matrix.label: Music feature warehouse
feature_matrix.representation_gap: Needs more public fixture variety across language, region, instrumentation, and production style.
feature_matrix.next_six_month_problem: Detect when recommendation data becomes polished, repetitive, or regionally narrow.
feature_matrix.visual_treatment: Segment clusters with drift bands and source-diversity counters.

feature_matrix.label: Industrial diagnostics
feature_matrix.representation_gap: Needs more machine families and noisy sensor fixtures.
feature_matrix.next_six_month_problem: Show how safety state, sensor uncertainty, and restart permission change under field noise.
feature_matrix.visual_treatment: Fault graph from signal to diagnosis to compliance to action.

feature_matrix.label: Edge review and boundary scoring
feature_matrix.representation_gap: Needs scenario fixtures for different oversight and human-control postures.
feature_matrix.next_six_month_problem: Represent when a route should pause for review without freezing useful low-risk work.
feature_matrix.visual_treatment: Boundary map with route action, risk bands, and review state.

feature_matrix.label: Industry transfer profiles
feature_matrix.representation_gap: Needs role-specific review views for each high-risk domain.
feature_matrix.next_six_month_problem: Show how the same runtime lane changes when the audience is clinical, legal, educational, or operational.
feature_matrix.visual_treatment: Domain cards with route anchors, proof files, and disagreement prompts.

feature_matrix.label: Repository growth and contribution health
feature_matrix.representation_gap: Needs time-series snapshots after GitHub traffic becomes available.
feature_matrix.next_six_month_problem: Separate real adoption signals from vanity metrics and stale publication artifacts.
feature_matrix.visual_treatment: Contribution health, proof freshness, and traffic trend panels.

feature_matrix.label: Research surfaces and model cards
feature_matrix.representation_gap: Needs clearer disagreement and uncertainty fields for each model card.
feature_matrix.next_six_month_problem: Make model comparison increase human understanding rather than compressing judgment into one score.
feature_matrix.visual_treatment: Model cards with open questions, evidence class, and next proof.

roadmap.label: Trace-ranked improvement backlog
roadmap.problem: The repo has proof exports but does not yet rank repeated weaknesses automatically.
roadmap.engineering_response: Mine execution journal failures and sparse proof lanes into scored improvement candidates.
roadmap.proof_to_add: proof/research-influence.md plus a regression test for backlog ordering.

roadmap.label: Role-balanced review fixtures
roadmap.problem: Some domains need structured disagreement before a final route is trusted.
roadmap.engineering_response: Add advocate, skeptic, and reviewer fixtures to bias, industry, and diagnostics lanes.
roadmap.proof_to_add: A fixture bundle showing where roles agree, disagree, and defer.

roadmap.label: Epistemic drift counters
roadmap.problem: A system can look stable while sources narrow, phrasing repeats, or humans stop checking.
roadmap.engineering_response: Add diversity, repetition, uncertainty, and human-review counters across proof surfaces.
roadmap.proof_to_add: A generated epistemic-risk report tied to music, research, and operator routes.

roadmap.label: Oversight-sensitive route policy
roadmap.problem: Trust depends on purpose, control, precision, and oversight, not model output alone.
roadmap.engineering_response: Attach oversight posture and human-control state to high-impact route responses.
roadmap.proof_to_add: A readiness export showing which high-impact routes have adequate review state.

clusters.why_it_matters: `stale-proof` appears across 2 failed or blocked traces in proof-export. A repeated trace pattern is stronger than an isolated note because it can be turned into a regression fixture.
`schema-drift` appears across 1 failed or blocked traces in api-contract. A repeated trace pattern is stronger than an isolated note because it can be turned into a regression fixture.

proposals.change_shape: Add a narrow fixture for `stale-proof`, bind it to proof/research-surfaces.json, scripts/export_research_surfaces.py, and promote the change only when the proof bundle regenerates without losing existing artifacts.
regression_tests: assert cluster `stale-proof` no longer appears across 2 traces
assert proof export still contains route, test, and artifact counts
proposals.expected_behavior: The next run should keep the successful traces stable while forcing this repeated weakness to appear as a testable failure if it returns.

proposals.change_shape: Add a narrow fixture for `schema-drift`, bind it to openapi/openapi.json, and promote the change only when the proof bundle regenerates without losing existing artifacts.
regression_tests: assert cluster `schema-drift` no longer appears across 1 traces
assert proof export still contains route, test, and artifact counts
proposals.expected_behavior: The next run should keep the successful traces stable while forcing this repeated weakness to appear as a testable failure if it returns.
proposals.rejection_reason: Support is not high enough to change the harness yet.

next_questions: What evidence would change the current regulated multimodal data decision?
Which claim is still relying on interpretation rather than measurement?
Can the disagreement be reduced to one observable test?

factors.note: How tightly the output can be checked against observable state.
Whether a person can pause, review, and correct the route.
Whether independent review is attached to the route.
Whether the claim has test, receipt, or benchmark support.
Whether a mistaken action can be unwound without hidden damage.
Higher-harm routes need a lower trust prior until reviewed.

indicators.label: Evidence diversity
indicators.evidence: 3 perspectives and 4 source types appear across 4 items.
indicators.correction: Add a second independent source class or dissenting review before reuse.

indicators.label: Unsupported certainty
indicators.correction: Require uncertainty fields beside every high-confidence claim.

indicators.label: Repetition pressure
indicators.evidence: 1 repeated claims were found after normalization.
indicators.correction: Cluster repeated claims and ask for a new measurement, not another paraphrase.

indicators.label: Human review gap
indicators.evidence: 1 evidence items were marked as human-generated.
indicators.correction: Keep one non-delegable human check before decision-grade use.

indicators.label: Freshness
indicators.evidence: 1 evidence items are older than 180 days.
indicators.correction: Refresh old sources or mark their domain limits explicitly.

non_delegable_checks: Name what the system did not observe.
Keep uncertainty visible beside any confident answer.
Require a human reviewer for high-impact or stale evidence.
